pages.text: Combine one iron ingot and one slimeball without a fixed shape.

Right-click within eight blocks to manage names, stats, orders, gear, and cargo. Keep the tuner in either hand. Shift-right-click with either tuner to preview work areas for 15 seconds: cyan marks range, gold marks the next section or registered plots. Use another held item for recovery.
The Creative Slime Tuner edits base stats and current resources in Creative only. It has no Survival recipe. Shrinking Capacity requires emptying the slots that would be lost.
